items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: As I was saying to George this morning at breakfast

ctx.x: Yeah. And I think it's -- they sacrificed the sort of beat you can dance to. And also, there was no -- I mean, if you take something like "Stomping at the Savoy," people when they left the ballroom, they may be only just humming two bars but there was something that stuck in your ear. With that new music, there was nothing for the public really to catch onto, I don't think.
As I was saying to George this morning at breakfast, I think it's a good idea the way you very often play the melody in that first chorus before you take off with it.
